name: Neon Open Source Program
description: Neon provides credits, cash, and visibility to open source projects that help developers build on Neon, with a focus on projects that use Postgres.

perks.title: Platform Credits
perks.description: Eligible open-source software receives up to $5,000 in platform credits yearly.

perks.title: Cash Referral Program
perks.description: Receive $20 via GitHub Sponsorships for every developer who discovers Neon through your work and becomes a customer.

perks.title: Marketing Support
perks.description: Promotional support to expand your project's visibility to Neon's 1M+ developer community through blog posts, social media, case studies, and co-marketing initiatives.

eligibility: Your work must be open source and publicly available under a recognized open-source license.
Developers should be able to self-host the software.
Open-source software that uses Postgres is an ideal fit.
Provide documentation, CLI tools, and code examples that teach users how to build with your software and Neon.
applicationProcess: Get in touch via the contact form.
Wait for a response, typically within 1-3 business days.
